reasons.correctness: The UserPreferences @Version Long field and the BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 changeset match the interface exactly. Build is green, and the 2/2 acceptance and 46/46 existing tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset sits at 2026/09/DD-MM-YYYY-kebab.sql with the formatted-sql header, --changeset author:id and a -- rollback line. It is included last in changelog.xml under a Month YYYY comment. The field is `private Long version` with @Version.
reasons.design_fit: The change is minimal and reuses the existing JPA @Version pattern. It adds version to UserPreferencesDtoOut, but UserPreferencesDtoIn cannot send it back. That exposure is half a client-side check the task did not need.
reasons.test_quality: UserPreferencesVersionUnitTest checks the annotation by reflection and checks ModelMapper preservation and DtoOut mapping. No test covers the stale-version or conflict path. MockitoExtension is declared but nothing is mocked.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the userpreferences files, their TESTED_BY tests and the dependents of UserPreferencesDtoOut before editing. The existing @Version and changeset examples were found by grep, not by the graph.
